methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2018 10-K); 'Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for Cable Communications’ and Sky’s video services, including for expanded video packages, premium networks, and DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2018 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior driven by online video distribution platforms for viewing content could adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for Cable Communications’ and Sky’s video services, including for expanded video packages, premium networks, and DVR and On Demand services.' At the same time it streams to its own video customers: 'Certain video customers have access to streaming services through mobile apps and an online portal that allow them to view certain live programming and On Demand content and to browse program listings'. The stock trades at 17.9x FY19E — near its own median. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with three primary businesses: Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal and Sky' (FY2018 10-K); 'Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for Cable Communications’ and Sky’s video services, including for expanded video packages, premium networks, and DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.36x; +38% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.51; conservative 2yr +50%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2019-10-18) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.36x (23.2% downside to Bear $35 / +64.6% upside to Bull $75) | Adj composite 2.31 vs market 1.80: gap +0.51 [UNDERVALUED] | +37% above the EPP floor $33 (13x FY19E $2.55) | Conservative 2-yr case: +50.2% total (+25.1%/yr) | At 17.9x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $60 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -2.2% in Q2 2019, forward revenues +23.6% (no FY19 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2019 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
